description: Creates or overwrites one whole file in the app's draft. Text (html, css, js, json, svg) goes raw in `content` and counts against the file cap. Binaries the code loads by path (images, audio, models, fonts) go as `contentUrl` or base64 `content`, count in MB, 25 MB max. Photos or items someone manages from the panel go to neblla_media. Standard paths: index.html, main.css, client.js, server/lobby.js, server/gathering.js, server/room.js. Waits in that env's draft until neblla_promote "save" with the same env ("pro": the users); "discard" drops that whole draft. More: neblla_get_llms tools/upload_file

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

content.description: Raw text, or base64 for a binary. Required unless `contentUrl` is set.

contentUrl.description: A public https URL Neblla downloads (no private or local address); not with `content`.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

ifVersion.description: The file's `sha` from neblla_list_files (not get_file's `version`): if it changed since, nothing is written; you get `stale`.

message.description: Note naming this version in neblla_versions; reuse it across a burst of uploads.

path.description: Path in the app, e.g. "server/room.js" or "img/logo.png".

name: neblla_upload_file
title: Upload files to an app
